description: This Java source file contains service implementations for managing images within the OFBiz framework, including uploading, scaling, thumbnail creation, renaming, and deletion of product images and their associated content resources.

classes.name: ImageManagementServices
classes.description: Service class providing methods for image upload, scaling, thumbnail creation, and management within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: addMultipleuploadForProduct
methods.description: Handles uploading multiple images for a product, including saving files, creating content, generating thumbnails, scaling images, and linking resources.

methods.name: removeImageFileForImageManagement
methods.description: Deletes an image file associated with a product based on provided content and product identifiers.

methods.name: scaleImageMangementInAllSize
methods.description: Scales an image into multiple predefined sizes based on configuration and saves these scaled images.

methods.name: createContentAndDataResource
methods.description: Creates a data resource and associated content record for an image, linking them within OFBiz.

methods.name: createContentThumbnail
methods.description: Creates a thumbnail content record and saves the thumbnail image file.

methods.name: resizeImageThumbnail
methods.description: Resizes an existing image to a thumbnail size and creates associated content records.

methods.name: resizeImageOfProduct
methods.description: Resizes a product image to specified dimensions and replaces the original image file.

methods.name: renameImage
methods.description: Renames a product image, updates related content and data resource records, and manages associated thumbnail images.
